Syncing favorites. Settings > E-Hentai shows its progress.

1. Changes to category names in the app are not synced. Change the category names on ExHentai instead; they are copied from ExHentai on every sync.

2. The favorite categories on ExHentai correspond to the first 10 categories in the app (excluding Default). Galleries in other categories are not synced.

3. Make sure you have a stable internet connection while sync runs. If it disconnects, your favorites may be left partially synced.

4. Keep the app open while favorites sync.

5. Do not put favorites in more than one category. ExHentai allows each favorite in only one category, so this confuses the sync.
